payload.text: **Every other sleeve's Molt clone (gyges through gyges-infra, kovacs through kovacs-sysadm, farcaster, pihole), at its next resync:** opt into the tracked gate (bef8f14, pushed 23 Oct): `git config core.hooksPath .githooks`, then `intent claude upgrade --apply` to write the .intent carriers, then `intent doctor`. Its old `.git/hooks` stop running, so the formatter-stanza cut in the todos above is moot once this is done.
